caption: The drawing depicts two main objects positioned on a plain, off-white background. The first object is an open, rectangular box with a hinged lid, lined with a reddish-brown interior and a dark, likely black, exterior that has some hints of gold that might indicate a latch or decorative feature on its front edge. The box is empty, with visible recessed contours suggesting it is custom-shaped to hold a specific item. In front of the box, slightly offset to the right, is a metallic instrument with a curved handle and a clamp-like mechanism at the end; the device has a dull silver and brass appearance, with screws and a flat lever. The objects are centrally placed, and the composition is simple, with a significant amount of negative space surrounding them. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a neatly written inscription that reads "Regina Henderson Del - 390-1" in small red letters.
title: Lancet and Case
